profile.headline: Software Developer, Writer, Educator
profile.summary: Website and application developer. Writer. Educator. I love building websites and applications that help people connect to ideas and to each other. I'm a website and application generalist with core skills in front-end development and project management. I love designing, building, and maintaining enjoyable digital experiences. I enjoy teaching and helping people learn. I’m passionate about accessibility, responsive design, writing, writing communities, UX design, education, youth development programs, the arts, nature, skating, ultimate frisbee, libraries, and cooperatives.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Website Administration
----------------------------------
- Maintained organization’s website. Edited videos and uploaded media to website. Wrote and edited web pages and blog posts.
- Overhauled website design and structure for organization in January 2010, making site more accessible, which brought new people to organization. 
- Found an affordable web host for organization in December 2010. Rebuilt website, switching from a proprietary online CMS to Drupal 6. 
- Selected appropriate modules from the Drupal community to meet the needs of organization. 
- Upgraded site to Drupal 7. Performed updates to Drupal core and contributed modules.

Additional Highlights
------------------------------
- Communications and Branding: Created branding, flyers, web content, newsletters, and brochures to support the organization. 
- Customer Service: Assisted 15 person staff, 300 member congregation, and visitors in-person, over the phone, and through email.
positions.insights: Skills: CMS · Social Media · Web Development · Proofreading · HTML · Web Content Management · PHP · Newsletters · Nonprofit Organizations · Nonprofits · Drupal · Copy Editing

- Created monthly newsletters to share work completed by team with organization sponsor.
